title: Dreminex Fashion Android Store App — GitHub Releases APK Distribution and In-App Updater
owner_goal: Separate Android customer store app linked to production website, installed from the existing website footer Install Dreminex App entry point as a signed APK hosted in public GitHub Releases, with native in-app version detection and user-confirmed update installation; absolutely no Google Play distribution or Play Core In-App Updates.

live_store.verification_status: prior connected-site context only; current storefront/PWA end-to-end audit not performed; web fetch was unavailable

architecture.v1_recommended: PWA + Android TWA with Kotlin native update-check/settings Activity; GitHub Releases as APK distribution source
architecture.android_builder: Android Studio Gradle + Bubblewrap/TWA; keep custom native Kotlin updater module/activity and release-channel configuration

alternatives.native_flutter_or_kotlin: Optional phase 2; requires a complete new UI and robust authenticated API/backend integration
alternatives.plain_webview: Fallback only if TWA unsupported and after security + Play policy review, not first choice

architecture.reason: TWA displays production-origin store, while a small native Android shell checks GitHub Releases and invokes Android system PackageInstaller after SHA-256 and signer verification; websites changes remain server-driven.

release_artifacts: signed customer APK uploaded as a GitHub Release asset
sha256 digest plus signed update manifest or GitHub release metadata

signing.release_keystore: Private: never commit to GitHub, APK assets, WordPress, or task reports; store encrypted/offline or in protected CI secrets
signing.one_stable_certificate: First public release and every future APK update must retain same signing identity; consider supported signer rotation only with documented Android compatibility constraints
signing.digital_asset_links: Publish actual SHA-256 fingerprint of same APK signing cert to production /.well-known/assetlinks.json after approval
signing.reproducible_build: version controlled Gradle settings, locked dependencies, CI release signing environment with protected tags and human approval
signing.package_name: Verify old installs; if migrating an existing Android APK use same applicationId and signer; PWA shortcut/WebAPK is not generally directly upgradeable into an unrelated native APK

versioning.version_name_semver: user-facing only; numeric Android versionCode is authority
versioning.min_sdk: derive from Android target devices; test current OS install policy
versioning.package_name_proposal: com.dreminexfashion.store (verify uniqueness and any existing release before using)

pwa.service_worker: review and preserve existing functional PWA plugin setup
pwa.offline: public/static cache only; offline cart/checkout transactions not supported
pwa.website_changes_sync: Network-origin content reflects newly published products, changes in prices, inventory, promotions, content, and theme; refresh/revalidation behavior depends on caching and connectivity.

commerce.v1_transport: Use original website TWA and original WooCommerce session/checkout
commerce.future_native_ui_source: WooCommerce Store API + explicit authenticated backend for customer-only private workflows
commerce.account_order_access: Only current authenticated customer, no global admin REST access
commerce.custom_payment_gateways: audit and test in website/TWA before claiming parity

versions_and_updates.distribution_channel: GitHub Releases, public repo or separate public releases repo; customers must not need GitHub login or app-embedded token

github_release.asset_validation: Select ONLY expected APK asset for configured repo; check final redirected host policy; never accept arbitrary user-provided APK URL
github_release.asset_digest: When available, use GitHub Releases asset digest sha256 and/or signed update-manifest SHA-256; independently calculate SHA-256 on downloaded file
github_release.api_failures: Use exponential backoff and cached verified latest release, not crash or block shopping; handle 404, 403 rate limiting, timeouts and revoked files
github_release.api_auth: Do not embed personal access tokens in client APK; use public releases or read-through cache on controlled origin if necessary

updater.component: Native Kotlin Activity/UpdaterRepository/Downloader/Installer integrated with TWA launcher; no privileged JavaScript bridge
trigger: on app launch once cache TTL expires
manual Check for updates item in native app settings
optional gentle update notification when new stable release confirmed
updater.mobile_data: Do not automatically download APK without user approval; show APK size and prefer Wi-Fi setting as user preference
updater.compare: remote version_code > installed PackageInfo.longVersionCode; no same-version reinstall or downgrades
updater.download: Android DownloadManager or safe streaming into app-specific cache with progress; HTTPS only; no broad storage access
validate: actual downloaded SHA-256 equals trusted manifest/release digest
APK signature certificate matches installed APK signing identity, or Android-supported verified key rotation
compatible minimum Android SDK / supported ABIs
updater.install: Use Android PackageInstaller or ACTION_INSTALL_PACKAGE with FileProvider content URI, correct MIME and user-consented system confirmation
updater.unknown_sources: On Android 8+ check canRequestPackageInstalls; when needed direct user to ACTION_MANAGE_UNKNOWN_APP_SOURCES for current app only; never bypass consent
updater.install_permissions: Evaluate REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES for app-initiated installer; keep no INSTALL_PACKAGES privilege, no Accessibility automation and no unattended install
prompt_type: Update available: version and release notes
updater.failed_install: Delete untrusted temp APK; leave installed app and website functionality untouched; diagnostic error without exposing secrets
updater.older_app_support: Optional minimum_supported_version_code for cautionary compatibility alert; do not lock customer out of website by default
updater.optional_verified_channel_manifest: Prefer signed update-manifest.json published with each GitHub release; include manifest-signature and trust public key embedded in APK, if designing an enhanced supply-chain check

direct_install_first_time.website_entry: Existing footer/button label Install Dreminex App
direct_install_first_time.on_android_browser: Show transparent explanation: Download Android APK (GitHub Releases) and installation guidance; never disguise it as Google Play
direct_install_first_time.existing_pwa_path: Preserve existing PWA install for non-Android platforms and as optional separate PWA choice; do not silently remove current PWA functionality
direct_install_first_time.existing_pwa_android: If an Android PWA/WebAPK already installed, inform user that signed APK is a distinct install and may coexist; verify UI/launcher name duplication and optional migration plan
direct_install_first_time.same_source_release: Download button should use latest verified stable GitHub Release APK matching app updater policy, not arbitrary hard-coded release version
direct_install_first_time.hide_or_change_cta_inside_twa: After confirmed Android shell launch, show Open App or Check Updates instead of re-install prompt; UI context flag only, never auth/security decision

notifications.web_push: evaluate support on target browser/TWA and current PWA plugin

tasks.title: Read-only storefront and PWA audit
actions: Confirm live domain, TLS, redirects, web manifest, service worker, mobile responsive breakpoints and Lighthouse PWA basics
Map all essential WooCommerce storefront journeys: home, search, category, product/variation, cart, checkout, payment, account, order status, contact
List which checkout/payment/account components are cross-origin, popup, JavaScript-driven, or incompatible with TWA and their return URLs
Inspect existing Dreminex PWA plugin if present and reuse functioning setup; avoid conflicting second manifest or service worker
Audit site CDN/page cache rules, especially account/cart/checkout/auth and dynamic prices/stock
acceptance: No duplicate service worker registrations or overlapping service worker scopes
Checkout and private/account paths are not served stale user-specific content

tasks.title: Separate app repo and immutable production origin
actions: Create Android-specific repository /android-store-app; do not merge with Dreminex Suite Native MCP project
Use website as the sole source of truth for product/catalog/price/stock/content/checkout for v1
Keep native APK packaging independent from WordPress plugins and server-side MCP infrastructure
Select final packageName and project display name after collision check; store package name and signing keys as protected release assets
Use exactly one customer GitHub-stable APK build channel; keep separate debug signing identities.
acceptance: No WordPress admin, OAuth MCP, API secret, customer token or private key embedded in APK
Staging/test URLs cannot enter production release accidentally

tasks.title: PWA assets and live website sync
actions: Verify/repair web app manifest with id, name, short_name, start_url, scope, theme_color, background_color, display and required icon sizes including maskable
Validate HTTPS, service worker registration, offline fallback, network retry and session handling
Never precache checkout, cart, account, payment, wallet or live stock/price API JSON as fixed snapshots
Use appropriate network-first/no-store semantics for live storefront and personalized responses
Ensure website catalog changes appear on next navigation/refresh without APK rebuild
Do not promise offline ordering; present informative offline fallback
acceptance: Changing site price/stock updates app display when online without APK version bump
No cross-customer cart/account data shown after sign-out or account switching

tasks.title: Build signed Android TWA and native Kotlin updater shell
actions: Create reproducible Bubblewrap Trusted Web Activity Android project from audited manifest
Use Digital Asset Links on /.well-known/assetlinks.json with actual release certificate fingerprints
Verify full-screen origin association, launch behavior and safe fallback on failed validation
Test internal links, app links, Android back, refresh, orientation, file chooser, camera intents and downloads where supported
Test all external payment redirects and return URL deep links; maintain https-only trusted origins
Include native update entry in launcher/settings accessible outside web page TWA content; do not expect web JS to invoke PackageInstaller directly
Ensure APK signing certificate fingerprint used for Digital Asset Links
outputs: signed release APK for GitHub stable channel
acceptance: Asset Links verification passes for final signed app
All expected internal site navigation stays within authorized experience
Payment completion/cancellation/deep-link return navigates correctly

tasks.title: Customer commerce parity
actions: Audit homepage, categories, search, variation swatches, price, stock, wishlists, offers, coupons, cart, checkout, shipping, COD and order tracking
Preserve existing WooCommerce session/cookie mechanisms in v1 TWA
Test BDT display and Bangladesh shipping location selection
Test login/logout, register/reset password, address changes and My Account flows
Test custom Dreminex checkout, delivery advance and wallet features only if exposed to customers in current storefront
Use WooCommerce Store API solely for possible future native UI, not admin WooCommerce REST API keys in device
acceptance: Storefront core purchase paths pass on real Android devices
Order placed in app appears once in WooCommerce; no duplicate charge/order submission
Stock and prices validated server-side at checkout

tasks.title: Customer notifications and permissions
actions: Decide whether web push is supported by target TWA/browser and existing website; otherwise implement opt-in Android FCM push as separate guarded module
Never enable marketing notifications without explicit user permission
Use backend-authorized events for order updates; avoid placing private order details in unprotected push payloads
Support Android notification channels, opt-out and token revocation on logout
acceptance: No unconsented notification subscriptions
Order notifications do not leak personal information to another user

tasks.title: Public GitHub Releases stable APK delivery and CI signing (NO GOOGLE PLAY)
actions: Inspect actual user-designated public GitHub repository and protect signing material
Configure versioned signed APK release via protected tags, stable channel and release notes
Publish APK, update-manifest.json, checksums.sha256 as GitHub Release assets
Derive latest stable from official GitHub Releases API or verified manifest endpoint; reject prereleases and foreign assets
Never use Google Play, Play Core or AAB release as an acceptance requirement
outputs: signed release APK + hash + release manifest
acceptance: Public latest-stable release has correct signed APK asset/hash
App update flow does not refer to Google Play

tasks.title: First install from existing website Install Dreminex App button and consented in-app APK updates
actions: Read-only inspect existing footer Install Dreminex App button on staging and production; identify actual PWA installer handler
On Android browser, change CTA to GitHub stable signed APK or an install landing page; preserve a PWA option for other devices
Implement app launch/manual version check, native update prompt, opt-in download, SHA-256 verification, signer and package/version validation
Use Android PackageInstaller and user confirmation, including Android 8+ Install unknown apps per-source permission guidance
Provide reliable error handling and leave prior installed app intact when update/download fails
Do not change production website until owner approves patch and staging test passes
acceptance: New customer taps website button on Android and can download approved signed APK from GitHub
User can start update from installed app with system confirmation
Same package, same certificate, higher versionCode updates over existing install without data loss
Website content changes appear without publishing new APK

tasks.title: Offline, telemetry and site outage handling
actions: Show meaningful offline/retry page, safe cached public pages only, and open-in-browser fallback
Detect site maintenance and timeout without exposing debug traces
Collect privacy-respecting performance and crash diagnostics with consent/legal disclosures
Implement deep link routing to product URLs, categories and account paths
Evaluate accessibility, Bangla/English rendering, image load, 4G/slow networks and smaller Android screens
acceptance: No app crash on network disconnect or server 503
Checkout is never queued offline

tasks.title: Customer privacy and application security
actions: No embedded wp-admin account, MCP OAuth token, WooCommerce Consumer Secret or WordPress Application Password in Android binary
Server remains authority for stock, price, delivery eligibility and final charges
Require HTTPS for trusted origins; protect WebView/TWA navigations and external intent handling
Review login session persistence, CSRF/nonce and payment redirects
Verify public privacy policy and user disclosures for direct website/GitHub APK distribution
Separate shopper app from staff/admin mobile app
acceptance: No admin endpoints or write-capable store secrets available to ordinary app user
Account/checkout session isolation validated

tasks.title: Acceptance test and staged release
actions: Test on real devices and Android emulator; multiple Android versions, mobile networks and accessibility settings
Test product/variation price and stock update from WordPress while app already open
Test order placement, payment success/cancel, guest & logged-in checkout, coupon, taxes/shipping and restoration from background
Test GitHub stable APK updates on real Android devices, starting with signed prior version
Require explicit owner authorization for any changes to live WordPress, GitHub publication or APK rollout
Test direct GitHub APK download/install/update chain from existing footer CTA on real Android devices
Test no Google Play dependency and no silent sideloading
acceptance: No regression in live website due to app launch
Production credentials and signing keys absent from repository
All critical tests pass before distribution

tasks.title: Production-ready GitHub updater failure handling, caching and observability
actions: Limit official GitHub latest-release API polling, honor rate limits/cache headers; no GitHub token in APK
On release missing or network failure keep store working; offer retry rather than corrupted download
Reject APK with missing digest, hash mismatch, package name mismatch, unsigned/mismatched signer or non-incrementing versionCode
Handle paused/restarted downloads and user cancellation without wiping login/cart data
Version-gate app-only functionality separately from website content
acceptance: No update installed on failed verification
Store remains operable during GitHub outage

tasks.title: PWA/WebAPK to GitHub native APK migration UX and installer ownership
actions: Inventory existing website PWA installer, manifest id/scope and any Android TWA/WebAPK package
Explain to existing PWA-installed users the native APK is a separate application if package identities differ
Prevent duplicate Install prompt inside installed TWA; keep PWA path discoverable
Verify Android OS permission for browser initial install and separate in-app update installer origin
acceptance: Existing PWA remains functional
APK installs with correct launcher identity
No silent PWA uninstall or cross-app data migration claim
